info.title: Kasify API
info.description:
## Versioning

All business endpoints are served under a `/v1` prefix (e.g. `GET /v1/properties`).
The OpenAPI spec at `/openapi.json` sits outside the version prefix because it
describes the API rather than serves business data. Within `v1` only additive,
backwards-compatible changes ship; breaking changes land at `/v2`.

## Rate limiting

Every endpoint is subject to rate limiting. When a bucket is exhausted the API responds with
HTTP `429 Too Many Requests`, a `Retry-After` header (seconds), and the standard error envelope:

```json
{ "code": "rate_limit.exceeded", "message": "Too many requests. Retry after 42 seconds." }
```

Default buckets (1-minute rolling window): 100/min per personal access token,
50/min per IP on `/v1/geo/...`, 100/min per IP on the Telegram webhook,
and 10/min per IP on the OpenAPI spec.
See the [Getting Started](/developers/getting-started) page for details.

get.description: Returns bookings, cleaning tasks, and other calendar events for the property within the [from, to] window (defaults to today through one month from today). Contractors see only events tied to tasks assigned to them.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional, defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional, defaults to one month after `from`. Window must not exceed 366 days.

200.description: Calendar events for the property within the window

400.description: Invalid `from`/`to` or window > 366 days. Returns `calendar.invalid_range`.

403.description: Caller lacks access to the property

get.summary: List calendar events grouped by property
get.description: Returns the caller's accessible properties, with each property's bookings and tasks for the requested date window (defaults to today through one month from today). Contractor properties only include events tied to the caller's assigned tasks.

parameters.name: to

200.description: Properties accessible to the caller, each with its events for the window

400.description: Invalid `from`/`to` or window > 366 days. Returns `calendar.invalid_range`.

get.description: Calls the Nuki Web API with the integration's token and returns every lock the account can see, annotated with which (if any) Kasify property each lock is already assigned to. Falls back to offline data with a `nuki_status` of `unauthorized` or `unreachable` when the API call fails.

400.description: Malformed integration id

404.description: Integration not found or not owned by the caller's account

400.description: Malformed integration id

post.description: Attaches either a Nuki smart lock (requires `nuki_smartlock_id` and `nuki_integration_id`) or a Unifi smart lock (requires `unifi_floor_id` and `unifi_door_id`) to the property. The Nuki integration must belong to the property's account.

requestBody.description: Smart lock details. Provide either the Nuki fields or the Unifi fields.

400.description: Neither Nuki nor Unifi fields were supplied. Returns `smartlock.invalid_params`

403.description: Caller is not Owner or Manager of the property

404.description: Property not found, or the referenced Nuki integration does not belong to the property's account

409.description: The smart lock is already assigned to another property. Returns `smartlock.already_assigned`

post.description: Generates an access code on each smart lock configured for the property. Codes are valid from the booking's arrival time until its departure time. Partial failures are reported in `failed_smartlocks` rather than failing the request. Restricted to owners and managers; staff and contractors are rejected.

200.description: Access codes created. `failed_smartlocks` lists any locks the provider rejected.

403.description: Authenticated with an API token (`api_token.requires_session`)

409.description: Name already used (`api_token.name_taken`) or active-token limit reached (`api_token.limit_reached`)
